statement: In source-described full input report 0x30, the left Joy-Con uses shared button byte 4 bits 0, 3 and 5 for Minus, left-stick click and Capture; left button byte 5 bits 0 through 7 represent Down, Up, Right, Left, SR, SL, L and ZL. Its packed 12-bit left stick occupies bytes 6 through 8, while physical values for the inactive right stick remain unmeasured.
